name: Boseiju
description: Millennia-old tree that grew above the skyline, later corrupted by Tamiyo.

description_citations.text: "Towashi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towashi's growth consumed the edges of Jukai and enclosed the grove of Boseiju, displacing forest kami.
timeline.quote: As Towashi's boundaries stretched outward, the city began encroaching upon the ancient Jukai Forest, gradually consuming its edges.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor brokered an agreement: Towashi would stop growing into the forest, Boseiju could not be cut down, and Jukai closed to mortals without the kami's permission.
timeline.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor brokers an agreement halting growth into the forest and forbidding cutting Boseiju.
timeline.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towashi grows upward and Boseiju is lost in the skyline.
timeline.quote: Towashi was forced to grow upwards instead

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Boseiju grows again until it eclipses every structure.
timeline.quote: began to grow once again

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo leads the Phyrexian assault and corrupts and bursts Boseiju.
timeline.quote: The tree itself was corrupted by Tamiyo

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaito learns Tameshi has moved his research to the Boseiju District and enlists his sister Eiko as a diplomat to guide him.
timeline.quote: Kaito lifted his head to find his sister standing several feet away.

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Eiko sets rules, including no weapons, and Kaito explains he is working for the Reckoners for the emperor's sake.
timeline.quote: "I'm doing this for the emperor,"

citation.work: Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward
citation.text: "Kaito Origin Stories: A Test of Loyalty & The Path Forward" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2021.

timeline.summary: Katsumasa assigns Kotori to a supposed Reckoner raid in Boseiju District with Veilshapers and an Imperial samurai.
timeline.quote: "Imperial-led mission—their samurai will brief you.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: The team breaks into the building and finds it is a Jukai hideout, not a Reckoner safehouse.
timeline.quote: "This place isn't Reckoner,"

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Jukai acolytes burst out with disruptors, and Kotori messages Katsumasa for clarification but receives no reply.
timeline.quote: No reply.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Kotori-Shorikai disable the Jukai fighters, then kill the last Jukai woman by crushing her throat.
timeline.quote: The woman crumpled to the floor, gurgling blood.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: A Veilshaper strikes at the river kami and the mech fires a dart without Kotori's command, killing him.
timeline.quote: The Veilshaper slumped to the floor, a steel dart protruding from a weak spot in his armor, just under his chin.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Kotori realizes there is a kami inside the mech.
timeline.quote: There was a kami inside the mech.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Katsumasa, controlling a Veilshaper remotely, tells Kotori to override Shorikai and seize control; she instead lets go.
timeline.quote: And she withdrew, letting go.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Shorikai reveals his true bound form and slays the remaining Veilshapers and the samurai.
timeline.quote: It took only a few more seconds to silence the others, including the injured samurai

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: The river kami escapes through a warped merge left in the wall.
timeline.quote: Then, the river kami floated into the distorted wall and disappeared.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Shorikai speaks to Kotori and proposes they take their own path; Kotori agrees.
timeline.quote: Take our own path.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Kotori-Shorikai leave the hideout under occlusion veil, fleeing Katsumasa.
timeline.quote: Kotori-Shorikai left the Jukai hideout and walked into the darkness.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: The builders of Towashi razed the forest but left Boseiju unscathed.
timeline.quote: Though they razed the surrounding forest, the builders of Towashi left Boseiju unscathed, shaping the city around the ancient tree.

citation.text: Branch of Boseiju (Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Boseiju bursts apart and oil pours from it, killing and dissolving the kami.
timeline.quote: Boseiju, the tree that once held this plane together, bursts apart.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito tells Kaya that Tamiyo has opened the scroll and is destroying Boseiju.
timeline.quote: And worse, Tamiyo did it. Opened a scroll.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito starts to climb Boseiju to confront Tamiyo and meets Nashi, who asks to try to reach his mother.
timeline.quote: That's my mom up there.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito gives Nashi a repulsor and they climb Boseiju together toward Tamiyo.
timeline.quote: Walk in the direction you want to go.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nashi calls to Tamiyo, who answers with his name before her body snaps around and she attacks.
timeline.quote: A shard of metal shoots toward them

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo urges Nashi to join Phyrexia, and Kaito tells him to retreat as they fight.
timeline.quote: In the light of New Phyrexia, all are one.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo overpowers Kaito with scrolls and hangs him above Towashi, offering him surrender.
timeline.quote: Kaito flips feet over head before he knows what's happened, dangling far above Towashi.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito cuts himself free and is caught by Kyodai bearing the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: it's the emperor.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer confronts Tamiyo, who holds Nashi and takes out the scroll bound by an iron band.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo reaches for a scroll at her waist, one bound with an iron band.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Empowered by Kyodai, the Wanderer cuts Tamiyo down.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo falls.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nashi, grieving, is comforted by Kaito, Kaya, the Wanderer and Kyodai.
timeline.quote: Even Kyodai wraps around them all.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo's memory, a being of floating characters, speaks and reveals she was sealed in the scroll for such a death.
timeline.quote: I am what remains of Tamiyo—her story unending.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer explains that Tamiyo's last act was a request that her missed shards and mouthed words showed, so the memory is true.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo was making a request, in the only way she could.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The destruction of Boseiju in the New Phyrexian Invasion kills many kami.
timeline.quote: With the New Phyrexian Invasion , the destruction of Boseiju caused the death of many kami.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Compleated Tamiyo corrupts Boseiju and faces Kaito and Nashi; the Wanderer kills her at the last moment.
timeline.quote: At the last possible moment, the Wanderer appeared and killed Tamiyo.

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor brokered an agreement halting Towashi's growth into the forest and forbidding the felling of Boseiju.
timeline.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

citation.text: "Boseiju", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Boseiju began to grow again until it eclipsed the city's tallest structures.
timeline.quote: It grew so large and so tall that it came to eclipse even the tallest structures surrounding it.

citation.text: "Boseiju", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Tamiyo corrupted Boseiju and the tree burst apart.
timeline.quote: Boseiju itself was corrupted by the compleated planeswalker Tamiyo

citation.text: "Boseiju", section "Corruption". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jugan collects the essences of the other dragons, places them in an egg with Ryusei, and the egg is sealed in Boseiju.
timeline.quote: The egg was sealed into the heart of Boseiju

citation.text: "Jugan", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After fifty years, Jugan is reborn as Kura, the Boundless Sky.
timeline.quote: His new form was that of Kura

citation.text: "Jugan", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jugan collects the other dragons' essences and she and Ryusei sleep in an egg sealed in Boseiju for fifty years.
timeline.quote: The egg was sealed into the heart of Boseiju , where it was nurtured for fifty years.

citation.text: "Ryusei", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The five dragons hatch, reborn in new forms; Ryusei becomes Atsushi.
timeline.quote: His new form was that of Atsushi , the Blazing Sky .

citation.text: "Ryusei", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Boseiju itself was corrupted by the compleated planeswalker Tamiyo

citation.text: "Boseiju", section "Corruption". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

pages_say.description: The great tree over Towashi that once held the plane together and is shattered by Tamiyo's reading.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.
